name: MindMirror
tagline: Analyses your AI chat exports to show your thinking patterns, blind spots and dependence.

awards: Best Advanced Data Science Track Hack - Bitcamp

problem: People do not see what their AI use reveals about how they think.
solution: Parses chat exports and scores cognitive dimensions with Gemini, plus predicted brain responses.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload an export and see your cognitive fingerprint.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Advanced Data Science Track Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Personal data exports make instant demos.
